name: Lombard LBTC
description: LBTC is a yield-bearing Bitcoin asset, 1:1 backed by native bitcoin, combining an institutional off-chain yield strategy with yield denominated in Bitcoin and full composability across DeFi. LBTC targets a 2.5% APY generated by an off-chain covered-call options strategy managed by Bitwise Investment Manager, LLC. LBTC is deeply integrated as collateral across DeFi applications on 10+ chains, allowing holders to earn yield and access liquidity. LBTC is secured by a multi-institution Security Consortium, and qualified custodians including Anchorage and Kraken.

name: SolvBTC
description: SolvBTC is a universal Bitcoin reserve token that connects Bitcoin’s value across blockchains, backed 1:1 by a transparent, secure reserve. It empowers you to tap into DeFi and CeFi markets effortlessly, transforming idle Bitcoin into a dynamic asset for lending, trading, or yield generation—while keeping you in full control.
